title: 多数元素
statement: 给定长度为 n 的整数数组 nums，返回其中的多数元素，即出现次数严格大于 ⌊n/2⌋ 的元素。数据保证多数元素一定存在。

en.title: Majority Element
en.statement: Given an integer array nums of length n, return its majority element, i.e., the element that appears strictly more than ⌊n/2⌋ times. A majority element is guaranteed to exist.

complexity.space: O(1) extra space (Boyer-Moore voting, excluding the input array)
complexity.officialRequirement: Official follow-up asks for O(n) time and O(1) space; the problem itself does not require it.
complexity.notes: n is the array length. Voting: when the count is 0, switch the candidate; add one for a match and subtract one otherwise; the final candidate is the majority element. Sorting and taking the median is O(n log n) and hash counting uses O(n) extra space; both pass the local tests but do not meet the follow-up.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is n; line 2 has n integers nums. stdout: one integer, the majority element.

complexity.space: O(1) 额外空间（Boyer-Moore 投票，不含输入数组）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方 follow-up 要求 O(n) 时间与 O(1) 空间；题目本身未强制。
complexity.notes: n 为数组长度。投票法：计数为 0 时更换候选，相同加一、不同减一，最后的候选即为多数元素。排序取中位数 O(n log n)，哈希计数 O(n) 额外空间，都能通过本地测试但不满足 follow-up。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n；第二行 n 个整数 nums。stdout：一个整数，多数元素。
